name: Sibling Rivalry
overview: Scripture highlights the value of unity among siblings, emphasizing how good and pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in harmony, as seen in Psalms 133:1. However, it also acknowledges the challenges of sibling conflict, noting that a brother offended is difficult to reconcile, likened to a fortified city in Proverbs 18:19. Wisdom is encouraged in communication, with Proverbs 15:1 teaching that gentle answers can defuse anger, while harsh words escalate strife. Furthermore, Proverbs 22:6 underscores the importance of early training in godly ways to foster lasting righteousness, which can help prevent rivalry and promote peace within families.
